headline: Tuesday, November 3 — Granite prep day, and the sky is set up for it.

items: Light rain most likely midday through this afternoon: 45% chance, gusty south wind to 18 mph
High 60, low 50, then clearing after 7pm for a dry, clear night
Sun up 6:35, down 5:06
The week: Wed mostly sunny 66/50, Thu sunny 69/49, Fri sunny 69/48, then dry
That sunny Wednesday is good news for the Watsonville drive
Waning half-moon in Virgo: detail moon, receipts moon, exactly the right energy for prep work

Mercury retrograde squares your Leo Sun (1.7°), the classic reread-everything transit: double-check the directions to 580 W Beach St, confirm the interview time, and say your answers out loud once before you lock them
Venus retrograde sits right on your Libra Moon (1.1°), with Pluto sextile it too: honest rapport lands easily under pressure, so the panel conversation is yours to warm up, not endure
Saturn trines your Sun (3.0°): steady discipline quietly pays
One catch: Mars square your Ascendant (1.4°), so budget your patience if anything runs long today
